column1: # Japanese counters and their sound changes (phase 1, 2026-10-08).
# counter: reading:class[:base]; counter_reading: counter:value (whole value) or
# counter:*d (value ending in digit d) -> the reading of that ending with its counter.
# 17日, 27日 ななにち, as the JSUT readings (2026-10-08). Was: しちにち.
# 一日中, 一年中: 中 after these counts reads じゅう.
# A number right after a label reads digit by digit: 内線214 にーいちよん.
# 泊 発 歩 品 敗 take ぱ after 3 and 4 like 分 (さんぱく; 2026-10-08). Was: class h.
# 半 after these counts reads はん (12時半, 3時間半).
# Counters from ja-tn-eval-v1 gap 4 (2026-10-09; readings reviewed by Claude as the native speaker).
# ja-tn-eval-v1 gaps 7-8 (2026-10-09; readings reviewed by Claude as the native speaker).
# counter_block: a word that starts like a counter but is not one (1足す いち足す).
# Remaining ja-tn-eval-v1 gaps (2026-10-09; readings reviewed by Claude as the native speaker).
# after_suffix / before_suffix: 後 ご, 前 まえ after a time count (3日後 みっかご).
# around_suffix: 頃 ごろ after a time, date or age count (8時頃 はちじごろ, 8時半頃 はちじはんごろ;
# 2026-10-11, after a TTS read はちじ頃 as ころ). 年頃 without a number stays a word.
# student_suffix: 生 せい after the count (1期生 いっきせい, 3年生の さんねんせいの; 2026-10-11),
# unless a word goes on (2024年生まれ, 3年生活).
# 月 before an amount or a frequency reads つき (家賃月8.5万円, 月2回); month_word: the kanji before
# 月 that make a word (今月 毎月 先月 …), month_rate_counter: the counts after it.
# Counters from the owner's evaluation sets (2026-10-14).
# 40肩 しじゅうかた, 50肩 ごじゅうかた (the idiom)
# 16号車 じゅうろくごうしゃ, 1〜2滴 にてき (owner v2, 2026-10-15)
